Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Han-Taun Overdrive $ 139.00 1 of 2 Select option Select option METALLIC GOLD - TWO WEEK BUILD TIME Qty $ 139.00 Add to cart View cart The Han-Taun is my take on the Klon Centaur overdrive so you know it sounds just as bad ass as it looks! It's pretty damn close to the legit Centaur reissue with a bit more beef and tighter high end. Makes any guitar stand out and totally slays on bass!!! SPECS: 4.7″ x 3.7″ x 1.18″ 1590BB sized enclosure, common 9vdc "CENTER NEGATIVE" 2.1mm BOSS style power input and battery snap. Current draw 20mA. Power supply not included. ***DO NOT USE ANY POWER SUPPLY RATED OVER 9VDC OR DAMAGE COULD OCCUR*** TESTIMONIALS: "Sounds great on my guitar pedal board and stacks well with everything. It might end up being my always on pedal. It also sounded nicely when I plugged into in my bass set up at practice last night. Even the guitarist and drummer approved. I might need to get a second." -Brian S. (Minnesota) "Maaaaaaaaan, the Han Taun is seriously a marvel, just a pleasant sound in this box!!!!!!!" -Christopher C. (California) "This thing is fucking beautiful. I'm no great bass player but this pedal is giving me a permanent attitude pout when I'm playing. It's gonna be my always on pedal. I mean, I only own two but, fuck...if anything ever happened to this Han Taun, I don't know what I'd do." Gary N. (Cyprus) "I received and tested the Han-Taun. Duuuuuuude....... why did I waited so long to get one? It is AWESOME!" -Angel V. (Maryland) "The Han-Taun rips, so thanks for getting me the klon sound without the $5,000 price tag." -Eamon S. (Texas) "I bought this from you a couple weeks ago and after putting it through its paces, I can safely and honestly tell you that this thing RRRRRRIPS! I'm a former Centaur owner (# 767 or 787). I loved it, but not enough to keep it when times got hard. The Han-Taun gives me the same sound, has better graphics, and can give me more muscle when I want it to." - Marc K. (Oklahoma) "Btw, the Han-Taun is awesome...keep up the good work!" -Jeremy K.
